title: Pure Diabolos
summary: The Diabolos strategy revolves around Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair and its classic counterparts, fueled by Lair of Darkness and the Ladies of Lament. Whenever you Tribute a DARK monster—including an opponent's monster turned DARK by Lair of Darkness—Darkest Diabolos revives itself from the hand or GY and rips a card out of the opponent's hand.

allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Lair of Darkness Field Spell.
allow.Eradicator Epidemic Virus: Tributes Darkest Diabolos (3000 ATK DARK) or an opponent's 2500+ ATK monster via Lair of Darkness to destroy all Spells or all Traps in the opponent's hand, field, and next 3 draws.
allow.Deck Devastation Virus: Tributes a 2000+ ATK DARK monster to destroy all 1500 or less ATK monsters in the opponent's hand, field, and next 3 draws.
allow.Full Force Virus: Tributes a 2000+ DEF DARK monster to destroy all 1500 or less DEF monsters the opponent controls/draws.
allow.Ballista Squad: Normal Trap that tributes 1 monster to destroy another card the opponent controls.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon that tributes itself to bounce a card and trigger Darkest Diabolos in the GY.

main: Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair

Signature 3000 ATK boss that cannot be Tributed or targeted by opponent's effects, Special Summons itself from hand/GY when you Tribute a DARK monster, and tributes a DARK monster to top/bottom-deck a card from the opponent's hand.
Diabolos, King of the Abyss
Classic Level 7 DARK Dragon Diabolos that inspects the top card of the opponent's Deck before their Draw Phase and places it on the top or bottom of their Deck.
Ahrima, the Wicked Warden
Discards itself to search Lair of Darkness, and tributes 1 DARK monster on the field to either draw 1 card or search a 2000+ DEF DARK monster (Darkest Diabolos).
Lilith, Lady of Lament
Quick Effect: tributes 1 DARK monster (an opponent's monster under Lair of Darkness!) to reveal 3 Normal Traps from the Deck and Set 1 to your field.
Malice, Lady of Lament
Quick Effect: tributes 2 monsters to recycle a banished or GY Normal Trap directly to your field.
Alice, Lady of Lament
Searches any Fiend with 2000 combined ATK/DEF (Lilith or Malice) when Tributed or destroyed.
Lair of Darkness

Core Field Spell that turns all monsters on the field into DARK, lets you Tribute an opponent's DARK monster once per turn to activate your card/effect, and generates Torment Tokens during the End Phase.
Terraforming
Searches Lair of Darkness.
Eradicator Epidemic Virus
Tributes Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's boss monster to obliterate all Spells or all Traps the opponent possesses.
Deck Devastation Virus
Tributes Ahrima or an opponent's 2000+ ATK monster to wipe out all handtraps and small starters in the opponent's hand.
Full Force Virus
Tributes Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's 2000+ DEF monster to wipe out low-DEF monsters.
Ballista Squad
Tributes 1 opponent's monster (under Lair of Darkness) to destroy 1 other card they control and immediately trigger Darkest Diabolos from hand/GY.
extra: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2 Dragon that tributes itself to bounce a card and trigger Darkest Diabolos in the GY.
